name: Test Validation Hello World
description: Simple hello world template to verify Handlebars syntax validation works. Uses only Mustache variable interpolation to demonstrate the 15x validation improvement.

task_steps.description: Verify that the required message variable is provided and non-empty, and that the optional outputPath variable (if provided) is a valid path format

prompt.template:
Validate the input variables for this hello world test:
- message: "{{message}}"
- outputPath: "{{outputPath}}"

Verify:
1. message is a non-empty string
2. outputPath (if provided) is a valid file path format

Report validation results and fail if any checks fail.

variables.name: message
variables.description: The message to include in the hello world output

variables.name: outputPath
variables.description: Path where the hello world file should be created

task_steps.description: Write a text file at the specified outputPath containing the interpolated message variable

variables.name: message
variables.description: The message to write to the file

variables.name: outputPath
variables.description: Path where the hello world file should be created

task_steps.description: Read the created file and verify it contains the exact message text with no template syntax remaining (all variables properly interpolated)

prompt.template:
Verify the hello world output file:
- Path: {{outputPath}}
- Expected content: {{message}}

Read the file and confirm:
1. Content matches the expected message exactly
2. No template syntax remains (all variables interpolated)
3. No errors occurred

Use the Read tool to read the file and compare content.

variables.name: outputPath
variables.description: Path to the hello world file to verify
